en.headline: Shop fire in Tai Po Fu Shan Street sends thick smoke skyward; 50 evacuate
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at a ground-floor premises on Fu Shan Street on Sunday morning; about 50 people left the area and no injuries were reported.
body: A fire broke out at a ground-floor shop on Fu Shan Street in Tai Po shortly after 10am on Sunday, sending thick smoke into the sky and prompting multiple emergency calls.

Fire services arrived and deployed a jet and a breathing-apparatus team. The blaze was brought under control within about 18 minutes. Around 50 people evacuated the vicinity on their own; no one was injured.
The cause of the fire remains under investigation. Local reports identified the premises as a traditional Chinese snacks shop or restaurant at numbers 63 to 65 Fu Shan Street.

zh.headline: 大埔富善街地舖起火濃煙沖天 約50人疏散無人傷
zh.dek: 周日上午約10時大埔富善街一間地舖發生火警，消防開喉灌救約18分鐘救熄，約50名市民自行疏散，無人受傷。
body: 今日上午約10時08分，警方接獲多人報案，指大埔富善街63至65號地下一間地舖突然起火，並冒出大量濃煙。
消防接報趕到，出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，約於10時25分將火救熄。事件中約50人自行疏散，無人受傷。
起火原因有待調查。有報道指事發地舖為中式傳統零食店或餐廳。
